evidence_level.justification: The study is a preregistered, single-execution numerical screening of a design space on L1a linear-vacuum equivalent-current fields: 128 scrambled-Sobol designs on a box that contains the sweep-v2 box and extends the wall-radius-to-pitch ratio to r_w / L = 1.24, plus the 96 accepted sweep-v2 designs rebuilt and re-solved as a held-out set, each solved on the accepted map and a 2x refined map, with the sweep-v2 builder rules and six metric gates verbatim, the cusp topology search v3.1 wall-cusp definition imported unchanged and the Koch design ratio reported per cusp as a field ratio. Its recorded outcome is accepted_l1a_sweep_v3 with all 11 binding integrity gates true; its preregistered hypothesis (H1: rho tracks I_1(x_w); H2: x* classifies the designs) was a reported test and did not hold as preregistered, and it is admitted at that recorded outcome. The framework admits accepted numerical evidence through a typed committed manifest, hashed artifacts at a resolvable revision, exact registered claim text and generated artifacts with provenance sidecars; that pattern is applied here through the numerical-screening gate GATE-L1A-SWEEP-V3 at the recorded outcome accepted-screening, the outcome of the sweep v2 whose box this study widens. The fields are not P2-qualified (the declared soft-iron pole pieces are vacuum in the field); the material-aware L1b/P2 confirmation the protocol queues for every design with r_w / L > 0.5 was not run. Nothing here is a plasma, wall-loss, confinement or performance quantity or a design recommendation; it is not the L1 field-resolved reduction of GATE-L1 (no manufactured solution, no L0 mapping, no performance model), not L2 and not L3, and it opens none of those gates.
evidence_level.name: numerical-screening

relation_to_levels.L0: independent of the algebraic L0 model; no mapping is claimed and no L0 quantity is computed
relation_to_levels.L1: solves linear-vacuum L1a screening fields on a wider design box; no field-resolved reduction, no material-aware field, no L0 mapping, no geometry-response prediction
relation_to_levels.L2: not coupled to any plasma model; the Koch ratio and every mirror descriptor are geometric field ratios offered to consumers under their label
relation_to_levels.L3: not particle-in-cell and not experimental; the launch-position analysis bound with the literature review re-reads sealed collisionless test-particle orbits of the geometry screening and is a recorded analysis, not a kinetic result

evidence_level.validation_status: none: no measurement, facility, or hardware comparison exists

permitted_claim_scope: terminal state, campaign status, design, gate, replay, stability, sensitivity and held-out counts of the single execution

the design box against the sweep-v2 box, the wall-radius-to-pitch and x_w ranges implied by the boxes and realised by the designs, and the Koch ratio per cusp in the conservative reading as a field ratio, with its ranges, histograms and band counts

the HEMP-like counts and their region (x_w, r_w / L, stage and cusp histograms), the five-stage four-cusp HEMP-like designs, the sweep-v2 region's zero count and largest ratio, and the wall reading below one at every cusp

the preregistered hypothesis statistics exactly as recorded (slope, R^2, band fraction, confusion table, accuracy, realised threshold, end- and interior-cusp medians) with the recorded outcome that neither H1 nor H2 held as preregistered, and the envelope reading that follows from the end-cusp values

the statement, bounded to the field model and the definition, that the sweep-v2 design box could not contain a HEMP-like cusp, and the labelled Discussion interpretation that the legacy parameterisation never sampled the ratio the HEMP criterion depends on

the recorded launch-position analysis of the bound literature review (launch cells by distance to the nearest magnet centre against their recorded reflections, the wall-loss campaign's launch offset from the magnet centres, the adiabaticity parameters and the magnetic-moment medians), cited as a recorded analysis of sealed orbits and never as a result of this campaign

the classification strings, the recorded outcome, the sealed claim boundary, the queued-not-run status of the material-aware confirmation and the catalogue's status as a consumer contract under its label
posthoc_audit_note: no post-hoc audit exists for the accepted bundle; every one of its 979 files is verified byte for byte by the generator and by the checker and no end-of-line tolerance is needed.
prohibited_inferences: plasma confinement, cusp-loss probabilities, wall-loss rates, thrust, efficiency or any thruster performance
reading the Koch ratio or any mirror descriptor as a probability or a loss fraction
that any HEMP-like design is a design recommendation, or that its ratio survives a material-aware field with iron pole pieces (the confirmation is queued, not run)
that the preregistered hypothesis held (it is admitted at its recorded outcome: not as predicted; I_1(x_w) is an upper envelope)
that a separatrix-bounded cell confines electrons or that the legacy multi-cell plasma picture is demonstrated
permanent-magnet or nonlinear-iron material behaviour, or P2 qualification of the screening fields
any kinetic-simulation, particle-in-cell or new orbit result (the launch-position analysis re-reads sealed screening orbits and is a recorded analysis)
field-resolved reduction, L0 mapping or geometry-response prediction (GATE-L1 stays closed)
opening of GATE-L1, GATE-L2 or GATE-L3
recorded_outcome_justification: The numerical-screening outcome accepted-screening names a field-only design-space screening on L1a linear-vacuum fields, the outcome at which the geometry sweep v2 is admitted. This study is the same kind of object: the sweep-v2 builder rules, solver, domain and metric gates applied verbatim on a wider design box, with the accepted sweep-v2 designs re-solved as a held-out set, the literature wall-cusp definition imported unchanged from the admitted cusp topology search and one further descriptor (the Koch design ratio) reported per cusp. Its sealed campaign status is accepted_l1a_sweep_v3 with every binding integrity gate true; the HEMP-like counts and the hypothesis outcome are reported, not gated, and are admitted exactly as recorded (the hypothesis did not hold as preregistered). A sixth outcome value would therefore not name a different kind of study; the existing outcome is reused so that accepted keeps meaning admitted as recorded, never that a positive finding, a design recommendation or a material-aware field is accepted.
